# Bundled browser dependency

`supabase-2.119.0.js` is the unchanged UMD distribution of `@supabase/supabase-js@2.119.0`, retrieved from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.119.0/dist/umd/supabase.js` on 2026-11-17. Its MIT license is in `supabase-LICENSE`.

It is served from Maniman's own origin so opening an unlocked vault does not execute a mutable CDN dependency. Upgrade deliberately and run the integration checks. No financial data is included in this file.
